newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways Feb same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways Feb same-store sales off.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Thursday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended March 1 fell 4.5 percent.
Total sales for the month were $155.81 million, off 6.9 percent from the $167.27 million reported last year.
Year to date, same-store sales fell 4.5 percent, and total sales were $487.52 million, off 7.4 percent from last year's $526.77 million.
Payless said the same-store calculation for the month of February excludes 14 store that closed in fiscal 1996.
Because of the 53-week reporting basis for 1996, the four-week periods for February are not comparable on a calendar basis, Payless said.

On a calendar basis, February same-store sales would have fallen 9.6 percent and total sales would have decreased 11.8 percent. Year-to-date same-store sales would have declined 4.1 percent and total sales would have fallen 6.8 percent.
Payless Cashways is a building materials retailer. At March 1, the company operated 192 stores in 22 states.
